cover: Deadly rail disaster strikes Spain as political crises test Latin America and Israel
cover_scene: A split composition showing emergency searchlights illuminating a twisted passenger train wreck beside an international negotiation chamber draped in multiple world flags.

slides.scene: Emergency responders and flashing sirens surround the twisted wreckage of a derailed passenger train on rural tracks under heavy twilight.
slides.headline: Spain Train Crash Kills Nearly Seventy
slides.body: A high-speed train derailment and collision in Spain left at least 68 people dead and dozens injured. Emergency responders rushed to the scene as leaked audio recordings revealed one train had been cleared onto an obstructed track.

slides.scene: A polling station room with a sealed transparent ballot box in the foreground and blurred Knesset hall architecture in the background.
slides.headline: Netanyahu Bloc Contests Disputed Election Outcome
slides.body: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu claimed an election lead before final tallies showed his coalition falling short of a parliamentary majority. His party alleged fraud, while opposition leaders began exploring options to form a rival government.

slides.scene: A commercial jet passenger door open against an overcast Miami skyline with an air stair positioned alongside.
slides.headline: Flavio Bolsonaro Rejects Brazilian Election Result
slides.body: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro fled to Miami and declared himself the rightful president-elect of Brazil, alleging the election was rigged. He pledged to lead opposition efforts from abroad as domestic leaders rejected his claims of fraud.

slides.scene: Heavily armored military vehicles kicking up dust on a rutted tropical street with local bystanders looking on.
slides.headline: El Salvador Deploys Troops to Haiti
slides.body: El Salvador sent 2,000 soldiers to Haiti to launch a rescue mission after four Salvadoran personnel were ambushed and reported missing outside Port-au-Prince. The major deployment marks an aggressive expansion of foreign security forces in the volatile Caribbean nation.

slides.scene: Military engineers assembling a heavy reconnaissance drone beside an olive-drab army truck in cold, mountainous border terrain.
slides.headline: India Approves Twenty-Two Billion Defense Expansion
slides.body: New Delhi cleared a massive $22 billion defense procurement package to modernize ground and air capabilities. The spending acceleration directly targets ongoing friction and border standoff readiness along the contested frontier with China.
